decided.title: Job applicants v. Workday: did its AI screen people out by race, sex, age or disability?
decided.status: Class certification sought Sept 14, 2026; hearing set for March 9, 2027. A separate age claim for applicants 40 and over was conditionally certified in May 2025. Workday denies its tools discriminate, and no court has found that they do.
decided.touches: Job seekers who applied through employers using Workday; the company says 356 million applications passed through its recruiting software in 2024

decided.title: Families v. UnitedHealth: did an algorithm cut off older patients' rehab care?
decided.status: Families allege UnitedHealth used the nH Predict tool to deny post-acute care claims without real human review. In March 2026 a Minnesota federal court ordered UnitedHealth to hand over documents on how the tool works. These are allegations; nothing has been decided on the merits.
decided.touches: Medicare Advantage patients sent home from hospital who need nursing or rehab care
